profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bridgewater Associates
profile.summary:
I enjoy solving large and complex problems! I spend my time designing and building highly-scalable, security-focused Kubernetes clusters that serve 200M+ users, 110k+ requests per second with millisecond latency and over 99.99% availability.

I have over 13 Years' experience in software development and specialize in the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and Docker container orchestration based on Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Create highly-scalable and secure Kubernetes infrastructure in AWS and Azure.
•Design, develop, and implement cloud infrastructure that supports dozens of microservices used by investment engineers across the company.
•Serve as subject matter expert in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and containerization of applications.
•Drive technical design and implementation of software and infrastructure.
•Create and enforce best practices for infrastructure and software.
•Assist and mentor other junior and mid-level engineers.
•Contribute across multiple businesses within the company, in both on-prem and multi-cloud
environments.

positions.title: Senior Staff Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
•Automate the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters in AWS, GCP, and Azure infrastructure.
•Create Kubernetes models used by customers to deploy the ForgeRock Identity Platform.
•Develop in-house Kubernetes operators using Go and Kubebuilder.
•Collaborate closely with application developers in the containerization and refactoring of applications into micro-services.
•Act as a specialist and evangelist for containerization and Kubernetes technologies.
•Mentor other engineers in areas like Kubernetes orchestration, containerization, and cloud infrastructure.
•Liaise with internal teams, partners, and customers.
•Benchmark and test the performance capabilities of Kubernetes deployment models

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Design, implement and maintain production Kubernetes clusters that serve over 100K RPS with millisecond latency and 99.999% availability hosted in AWS cloud
•Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 50% by optimizing network architecture, resource allocation in the VPC and by improving EC2 utilization.
•Restructured over 60 backend apps to run as docker microservices on Kubernetes
•Developed an automated platform to provision on-demand Kubernetes clusters based on kube-aws and Kubernetes APIs 
•Create CI/CD pipelines using tools like Git, Jenkins, Spinnaker and K8s API
•Implement metrics and monitoring systems using tools like Prometheus operators, SignalFx, and Splunk
•Continuously research ideas and technologies to improve security, reliability, performance, and scalability of production systems
•Mentor and train other engineers in areas like infrastructure, CI/CD, Kubernetes

positions.title: SSD Firmware Validation Engineering Lead
positions.description:
•Develop validation libraries and automation frameworks  written in Python
•Led agile rituals like daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews
•Engage early in the product development lifecycle to define tools, infrastructure, and FW capabilities and validation strategies
•Provide recommendations during product release approval process
•Architect validation plans, timelines and test strategies for various product lines
•Lead a remote team (Canada, California, Colorado, India) of 10 engineers 
•Collaborate with other developers to ensure long term stability of the test framework
•Mentor and support other developers

positions.title: SSD Firmware Validation Developer
positions.description:
•Develop and maintain Python applications.
•Develop validation strategies that meet strict coverage and timing requirements 
•Collaborate with ASIC, Product Engineering, and FW teams to drive resolution of system issues
•Numerous and extensive contributions to the Test Development Framework

positions.title: Test Development Engineer
positions.description:
•Collaborated with various engineering teams to optimize and automate processes with verifiable improvements in quality and cost reductions
•Develop and maintain high-performance functional tests in C/C++/Assembly
•Project lead for 21nm 64Gb NAND flash (80Series MLC/SLC). 
•Provided cost-effective solutions for production test flows, interface hardware and test equipment, redundancy analysis schemes, data reporting and monitoring, and device yield optimizations
•Recognized for performance, communication skills, data recording and analysis, commitment and team leadership skills

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•Develop high-performance imaging processing software in C++
•Designed circuit architectures ported to XILINX FPGAs
•FPGA circuit design for power and resource-critical applications
•Designed and implemented a memory management subsystem for image processing

publications.title: Field-Programmable Gate Array Design Of A Scalable Parallel-Accessible Memory Subsystem For Image Feature Extraction
